guide.title: Setup guide
guide.subtitle: Step-by-step instructions for using SmartPlug on web and mobile.

login.title: 1. Log in with your phone
steps: Open SmartPlug and enter your phone number in international format (e.g. +1234567890).
Enter the one-time code sent to your phone.
In development, visit /login?dev=1 for an auto-fill OTP panel.

household.title: 2. Create a household
steps: Give it a name such as Home or Office.
You can create multiple households to separate locations.

addDevice.title: 3. Add a device
steps: Claim code (web or mobile): enter the serial (e.g. SN-2026-000001) and pairing token, then link to a household.
Wi-Fi setup (mobile): put the plug in AP mode, connect to SmartPlug-XXXX Wi-Fi, enter home Wi-Fi credentials and serial in the app.
The device must connect to the internet and MQTT before it shows as online.

control.title: 4. Control power
steps: Open the dashboard to see all devices in the selected household.
Tap the power toggle to turn a plug on or off.
Green online badge means the device is reachable; offline means it lost connection.

share.title: 5. Share access
steps: Go to Shares and invite someone by phone number.
Choose permission: view (read-only), control (toggle power), or admin (manage device).
They accept the invite from their Shares page.

troubleshoot.title: 6. Troubleshooting
steps: Device stays offline: confirm home Wi-Fi password, serial matches the label, and MQTT broker is reachable.
Cannot register: pairing token may be expired (24 h) — generate a new one from Add Device.
No control permission: ask the device owner for control or admin access.
For deployment details, see docs/fa/START_HERE.md in the project repository.
